chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey: Chapter 94 - The Power Gap Between Mortal and Immortal
chapter_meta_description: Han Li demonstrates the absolute power of a cultivator by systematically annihilating the entire Wild Wolf Gang army with his mastery of the Fireball Technique and the Smoke Step.

og_description: Facing the Wild Wolf Gang's final stand, Han Li unleashes a terrifying melee application of the Fireball Technique, turning an entire army to ash.
twitter_title: Han Li shows the Wild Wolf Gang what a cultivator really is.
